notes.title: Extra Chapters on the Credits page!
notes.content:
The first ever update is out and now you can play the Extra Chapters written by the backers!

The extra chapters are available on the Credits page by clicking on the "Play Extra Chapter" button located on the side of the backer who wrote the chapter.

This update also includes some minor bug fixes and improvementes.

notes.title: Unforgettable is Open!
notes.content:
The bar is open! Unforgettable has just been released!

Thank you for all the backers and for those who helped me along the way. It has been a pleasure to make this game and I hope you enjoy it!

If you find any bugs, sorry about that, please report them at the pinned discussion in the community!
